messages:
alex: Hey — addressed all comments on #4823. Moved retry logic into client lib, added integration test, bumped changelog. PTAL when free. Link: https://git.redwood.company/infra/pr/4823
maria: thanks! can you paste the smoke command you used?
alex: sure: `./scripts/smoke.sh --target=staging --suite=retries` Passed locally + in CI. I also added a small fixture to make the test deterministic.
jamal: pinging for an approver — is this safe to merge into main ahead of the canary window?
alex: i think so. no schema changes, only client-side move. perf diff is <1%. would prefer merge today if we can get one approver. @maria any chance?
maria: i'll take a look in ~30m. if it's small i'll approve, else will comment.
deploy-bot: CI: tests passed (unit: 112/112, integration: 8/8) — sha abc123. :white_check_mark:
alex: thanks! addressed jamal's nit about a race on teardown and pushed a fix (`force-close` flag). PTAL again.
maria: quick q — can we add a short note in the retry README about behavior change?
alex: yep added a one-liner under "client retries" and pushed. also added a small example.
jamal: lgtm from me. i left an optional comment about naming but nothing blocking.
maria: reviewed, left one small doc nit, approved once that's in.
alex: pushed doc nit fix. thanks both. who wants to take merge ownership? i'll coordinate canary.
ops-bot: Canary queue: next free slot in ~2 hours. To reserve, comment "reserve-canary". Use format: `reserve-canary #pr 4823 owner:alex`.
maria: reserving now — `reserve-canary #pr 4823 owner:maria` :thumbsup:
alex: awesome — i'll monitor canary and rollback if any regressions. deploying after merge.
maria: approved and merged in 1768801300. :rocket:
alex: thanks! will follow up with post-deploy smoke and link results.
